start.title: Getting started
start.text:
muOS Anbernic Manager runs on this computer and looks after Anbernic or TrimUI handhelds on MustardOS: games in Roms/, box art, apps, updates, saves, BIOS, emulator choices and device settings. The sidebar groups Library (Games, Play, Artwork), Handheld (Apps, Device Settings, Themes, Emulation, Files), Tools (System Tools, SSH) and Manager (Settings, Wiki, Assistant).

Three ways to connect: (1) Card reader — TF2/games card in this computer, fastest for many games and needed for Install MustardOS. (2) USB — set USB Function to MTP on the handheld, then plug in. (3) Wi-Fi — same network; turn on SFTP + Filebrowser for files and Secure Shell for apps, themes, settings and TF2 over Wi-Fi. Set the address under Overview Wi-Fi settings.

Never invent walkthroughs; point people to GameFAQs, StrategyWiki or a game-specific wiki.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Shows whether the handheld is connected and how (card reader, USB or Wi-Fi), free space, how many systems have games, and Wi-Fi settings (address, Find on network). Connection help lives here when something is offline.

games.title: Games
games.text: The Roms/ library: every game file under Roms/<SYSTEM>/, with box art and LaunchBox descriptions. Filter by system, genre, rating, year, search, and On TF2 vs Roms library. Transfer copies picked games to the handheld. Add games drops files into the right system folder. The game viewer shows description, video, related titles, library check and BIOS needs.

play.title: Play
play.text: Play time, recently played and collections live on SD1 inside the handheld. Needs USB or Wi-Fi (not a games card alone).

artwork.title: Artwork
artwork.text: Fetch box art, screenshots and descriptions from libretro thumbnails and LaunchBox. Scrape missing art; send or get artwork between Roms/ and the handheld catalogues.

apps.title: Apps
apps.text: MustardOS apps from the market or your apps folder. Send packages to ARCHIVE; Install runs Archive Manager over Wi-Fi with SSH. Filter by what runs on the current model.

handheld.title: Device Settings
handheld.text: Change MustardOS settings over Wi-Fi with SSH. Some apply right away, others on next menu load, Wi-Fi connect or reboot.

themes.title: Themes
themes.text: Install themes over Wi-Fi; Theme Designer makes .muxthm packages. Needs MustardOS that keeps themes as folders.

emulation.title: Emulation
emulation.text: Cores, BIOS, Saves and RetroArch tabs. Cores and BIOS need Wi-Fi with SSH. Saves can be backed up to the backups folder.

files.title: Files
files.text: Browse this computer and the handheld (SD1 and TF2) over card reader, USB or Wi-Fi. Copy, rename and delete; renaming on the handheld over USB is limited — use Wi-Fi or a card reader.

tuning.title: Game Tuning
tuning.text: Per-game RetroArch options and cheats over Wi-Fi with SSH. Changes apply the next time the game starts.

system.title: System Tools
system.text: Install MustardOS (card reader only): write an image from os/ onto SD1 and verify. Set up TF2: format exFAT named TF2 and create ROMS folders — card reader or Over Wi-Fi (formats /mnt/sdcard only; never SD1). Reset card: wipe to empty FAT32 or exFAT — card reader or Over Wi-Fi for TF2. Confirm by typing the disk id or TF2. Back up saves first.

ssh.title: SSH
ssh.text: Terminal to the handheld over Wi-Fi. Needs Secure Shell on. For people comfortable with Linux commands.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Roms and other folders, copy art, startup, appearance, game data download (LaunchBox descriptions), cache clear, activity history and factory reset. AI assistant keys are configured here under Assistant.

wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.text: Plain-language help for every section, glossary and troubleshooting. The ? button opens the article for the current page.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.text: Optional chat that uses your own free API key (BYOK). Open it from the mustard chat button in the bottom-right corner or Assistant in the top bar after saving a key under Settings > Assistant. It knows the manager wiki, your Roms library and LaunchBox metadata, and the current connection. Replies use Markdown (including tables). It does not invent walkthroughs - it points to GameFAQs, StrategyWiki or game wikis. It cannot format cards or change the handheld; use System Tools and the other sections for that. Keys stay in the manager cache on this computer and are sent only to the provider you choose. Groq free chat models: openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b, qwen/qwen3.8-27b.
